recalled_knowledge.item: Operator-to-Lagrangian mapping O1<->L1, O4<->L15, O6<->L4, O10<->L2, O11<->L3 for comparing with Table S6
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Anand, Fitzpatrick, Haxton (2014) as used by P003/P016

recalled_knowledge.item: Chernoff half-chi-square asymptotics for q0 with a boundary at s=0; Wilks' theorem
Toy-MC p0 definition (fraction of background-only toys with q0 >= observed) as the Baxter et al. 2021 recommendation cited by LZ
Heavier low-d tail of the signal PDF at fixed S1c arises from the NEST photon-electron anticorrelation (a high-Nph fluctuation selects a low Ne)

failed_or_abandoned: Unbinned single-event term with a continuous S1c background density inside the 250-500 phd panel: the S1c dependence is not published; replaced by stated within-panel shapes (the residual -0.3 sigma lives here; DR-002).
Inverting the Fig. S1 68/95% MSSI contours into a 2D PDF: contours of a PDF dominated by low S1c cannot be inverted uniquely; Fig. 5 projections used instead.
First single-run script design exceeded the 10-minute foreground limit for toys; restructured into stages and parallel toy runs (one run capped at 8,559 toys by the in-script 540 s guard).
